canonical_source.behavior: The source renders Open logs only inside the successful snapshot branch. Loading and refresh failure clear or withhold the snapshot, so the logs navigation is absent until a real System Health snapshot exists. The control is read-only navigation to /module/logs.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: A tenant-scoped GET-only System Health snapshot is read from RuntimeHealthService. The Open logs anchor is rendered only after that authoritative snapshot succeeds and only when the exact registered Logs route/API and required permissions are present.

authorization.csrf: not applicable to GET/HEAD-only snapshot and navigation; POST is 405

tenant_isolation.idor_surface: No user/site/resource ID is accepted by the control. TenantContext remains server authority and foreign tenant direct access is 404.

runtime_boundaries.health_read: RuntimeHealthService status probes only; no state mutation
runtime_boundaries.secrets: no credentials or exception text returned
runtime_boundaries.wordpress_connector: no Connector or WordPress mutation or credential access added

truthfulness.request_failure: Open logs hidden and failure panel rendered
truthfulness.invalid_or_foreign_snapshot: Open logs hidden and invalid-snapshot panel rendered
truthfulness.successful_snapshot: Open logs may render only if the destination RBAC/API contract is also exact

acceptance_tests.coverage: snapshot gating, exact operation marker, tenant-derived href, permission fail-closed behavior, API contract fail-closed behavior, tenant encoding, no mutation method

canonical metadata, GET-only snapshot route, auth/RBAC, foreign-tenant 404, query/direct-ID non-authority, secret non-exposure, no persistence mutation, Logs destination RBAC, exact production binding

terminality.basis: Real source-equivalent conditional navigation is bound to the exact canonical operation ID in production code, backed by a genuine tenant-scoped System Health read, and covered by deterministic tenant/security tests. Official generator materialization is required before integration.
